body:
## Pull request overview

This PR comprehensively enhances the CRM example metadata to transform it from a minimal demonstration into a production-ready reference implementation. It addresses all P0-P3 requirements from issue #701 by adding reports, expanding seed data, implementing junction objects for many-to-many relationships, enhancing the dashboard, and creating additional utility pages.

**Changes:**
- Added two production-ready reports (Sales Report and Pipeline Report) with native `type: 'report'` navigation integration
- Implemented two junction objects (`order_item` and `opportunity_contact`) with full CRUD support and 19 seed records
- Expanded seed data from minimal (2 users, 2 orders) to comprehensive (7 users across roles, 7 orders covering all statuses, 2 inactive products, event participants)
- Enhanced dashboard with dynamic "Revenue by Account" widget using object aggregation
- Added Settings and Getting Started pages for better UX

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/src/objects/order_item.object.ts | New junction object linking orders to products with quantity, pricing, discount, and line_total fields |
| examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity_contact.object.ts | New junction object linking opportunities to contacts with role and is_primary fields |
| examples/crm/src/views/order_item.view.ts | Grid view and form definition for order line items with pricing sections |
| examples/crm/src/views/opportunity_contact.view.ts | Grid view and form definition for opportunity-contact relationships |
| examples/crm/src/actions/order_item.actions.ts | Adjust quantity action for line items |
| examples/crm/src/actions/opportunity_contact.actions.ts | Set as primary action for contact relationships |
| examples/crm/src/index.ts | Added exports for new objects, views, and actions (order_item, opportunity_contact) |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Registered new objects/views/actions; added sales_report and pipeline_report with proper schema; added Settings and Getting Started pages; enhanced branding with logo/favicon; added Revenue by Account dashboard widget; expanded seed data (7 users, 7 orders, 2 inactive products, 12 order_items, 7 opportunity_contacts, event participants) |
| ROADMAP.md | Added completed checklist for CRM Example Metadata Enhancement section documenting all P0-P3 achievements |
</details>

The ROADMAP claims that `backgroundColor` was added to the branding fields, but the PR description correctly notes that "backgroundColor is not supported by the `@objectstack/spec` branding type" and it was not actually added to the code. The actual code only includes `primaryColor`, `logo`, and `favicon`, which is correct according to the spec. Please update this line to remove the mention of `backgroundColor`.
